subject: Quarter kickoff — OKR brief + proposed canary rollout
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter kickoff — OKR brief + proposed canary rollout

Team,

Attached is the working deck (Q2_OKR_slide_deck_v2.pdf) and the operational runbook for the canary (canary_runbook.md). This thread is to get leadership alignment and sign-off so Product, Eng, and CS can lock owners and timelines for the quarter kickoff materials and the QBR. Summary below — please skim and respond with approval or blocking concerns by EOD PT tomorrow.

Top-line ask
- Please confirm: OKR owners, primary metrics, and the canary rollout window (week of 6/19)
- If any redlines on success criteria, call them out now so we can iterate the deck

Proposed OKRs (high level)
- Platform reliability: reduce tail latency P99 by 15% vs baseline (owner: Vivek)
- Cost/unit: reduce serving cost per million tokens by 12% (owner: Hannah)
- Product velocity: launch canary for model A/B routing + fallback policies (owner: Alex)

Canary plan highlights (see runbook)
- Canary window: 6/19–6/25 (gradual ramp to 10% traffic, stop criteria detailed)
- Safeguards: automatic rollback on latency/SLO breaches, manual kill switch with CS pager
- Stakeholder ops: CS to own customer comms for invited early accounts (Monica)

Risks & mitigations
- Risk: false-positive regressions from new batching knobs —> mitigation: hold stable config as fallback and run traffic split experiments
- Risk: under-resourced rollback support during weekend —> mitigation: schedule on-call rotation and 2-hour escalation SLA

Next steps (if approved)
1) Leaders to confirm owners and rollout window (reply on this thread)
2) I’ll post the final deck and schedule a 30-min pre-canary sync (invite to follow)
3) Monica & CS to draft the QBR slide for customer impact and runbook ops

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Sr. Product Manager, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_OKR_slide_deck_v2.pdf (pdf), canary_runbook.md (text)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — OKR brief + proposed canary rollout

Alex — thanks for pulling this together. A couple quick notes after a pass through the deck: 

- Cost/unit OKR looks good; I want the success metric to include a stability constraint (e.g., no >1% increase in error-rate). Can we add that to the owner slide?
- For the canary window: 6/19 is fine, but request the initial ramp to be limited to 4% for the first 24 hours (instead of jumping to 10%) to reduce noisy regressions.

I'll be the owner on the measurement side and will add the stability constraint to the deck if that's acceptable. Otherwise I approve the approach.

Hannah
Director, Platform Economics
Redwood Inference

- Slide 4 (owners): please add a deputy for each owner (two names) so we have coverage during travel/weekends
- Slide 7 (customer list): flag BrightHex as an invited early account and confirm Monica will lead comms; cc Beth from BrightHex once timeline is firm.

Assuming those two items are updated, consider this approved from the GTM/leadership side. Please loop in Monica to confirm comms timeline and include the Drive link to the finalized deck.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses and the useful clarifications. Final notes and actions below: 

1) Approved items: owners as listed, canary window 6/19–6/25 with initial ramp 4% for first 24 hours, stability constraint added (no >1% error-rate increase).
2) Action items: 
   - Alex: update slide 4 with deputies and publish final deck to Drive (link below) — DONE
   - Hannah: add the stability metric to the OKR measurement rubric — IN PROGRESS
   - Monica: lead customer outreach; Beth (BrightHex) is looped for awareness and will confirm availability for the invited slot on 6/20
   - Vivek: schedule on-call rotation and confirm rollback owners in the runbook
3) Links & artifacts: final deck https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cOKR-deck-v2; runbook updated in JIRA INF-1128; HubSpot record HS-573920 will be updated with the customer comms plan.

If nobody objects by EOD PT Thursday I'll mark this as formally signed and instruct Ops to open the canary checklist. Thanks everyone for the rapid turnaround.

Alex Martinez
